common_delta: Keep C09.var04/local one BASE-01 mechanic, two simultaneous primary system repairs and all inherited mission/failure settings. Add one same-type mechanic at BASE-02 and a BASE-01 borrowing route. Only ProblemDescription.PDESC and ResourceRemoteSupport.TFRS vary across the three arms.
predeclared_hypothesis: At fixed seed, both aircraft fail at the same mission return and first repair occupies the one local mechanic for 0.5 hour.

The second repair has an estimated local resource wait of 0.5 hour; a 0.25-hour remote forward trip should be borrowed, while equal 0.5-hour and longer 0.75-hour trips should not be borrowed if the documented strict comparison is implemented.

All arms import/export exactly and convert with zero errors; native event logs and aggregate resource conservation decide the behavioral conclusion. If native estimated wait differs, report the observed boundary rather than treating the hypothesis as established.
limits: A fixed seed and one replication cannot estimate borrowing frequency or establish every local-wait calculation rule.
This isolates one direct primary system repair resource at two stations; other tasks, shifts, multiple simultaneous remote resources and return-priority behavior are outside scope.
No general cost, performance, GUI visual or cross-engine claim is inferred.
